title: Summarise the sources and say which to trust
title_ar: لخّص المصادر وقول نثق في مين

scenario.en: Your neighbourhood group has four documents about the district and no time to read them all.
scenario.ar: مجموعة الحي عندها أربع مستندات ومافيش وقت لقراية كلها.

source: A council statement announces repairs but gives no cost, contractor or timetable. An inspection report lists seventeen sites investigated, four approved, with dates. A local article quotes three residents about cancelled deliveries. A contractor newsletter, published by the company awarded the contract, calls the new system transformational.

task.en: Summarise what each source offers, contrast their reliability, then say which you would trust.
task.ar: لخّص كل مصدر بيقدّم إيه، قارن مصداقيتهم، وقول انت تثق في مين.

key_points.en: Summarise what the inspection report offers.
Summarise what the local article offers.
Contrast reliability: the newsletter has an interest.
Say which source you would trust and why.
key_points.ar: قول تثق في أنهي مصدر وليه.

model_answer.en: To summarise both views: the inspection report gives seventeen sites investigated with dates, whereas the local article gives residents' experience of cancelled deliveries. The key difference is interest — the contractor newsletter was published by the company awarded the contract, so it cannot be treated as evidence. My own view is that I would trust the inspection report for facts and the article for effects.
model_answer.ar: تلخيصًا للرأيين: تقرير الفحص بيقدّم ١٧ موقع اتفحصوا بتواريخ، في حين إن المقال المحلي بيقدّم تجربة السكان مع إلغاء التوصيل. والفرق الجوهري هو المصلحة — نشرة المقاول نشرتها الشركة اللي خدت العقد، فمايصحّش نعتبرها دليل. ورأيي إني أثق في تقرير الفحص للحقائق وفي المقال للآثار.
